title: 全国秋季地区大会・競争水準と県補正の予測寄与（診断版）

method.strength: School Rating at first recorded game per tournament; averages of tournament means, not team-strength estimates corrected for seeding.
method.B: School Rating + prefecture strength component, no matchup component
method.C: Current saved pre-match expected win probability, including prefecture matchup and school rematch if active
method.prediction_metric: Brier score and log-loss (lower is better). Positive full_minus_school_brier means full model worse.
method.validation: In-sample retrospective pre-match replay, NOT genuinely held-out seasons; no causal claims. Historical match and prior coverage varies.
method.inter_pref: Only opposing schools mapped to distinct prefectures; incomplete school IDs are excluded.
method.area_notes: Tokyo competitions separated when tournament title denotes Tokyo; Kanto is a separate group. Hokkaido treated as a single region.
